name: Projection Engine
text: Once per scene, state a conclusion about a person or plan. If the Narrator confirms it, gain 2 Momentum; if not, the Narrator gains 1 Threat.

effects.text: +2 Momentum on a confirmed projection

name: Data Without Context
text: After an hour with records, ledgers or testimony, reduce the Difficulty of your next UNDERSTAND test about them by 1.

effects.text: -1 Difficulty on the next UNDERSTAND test about studied records

name: Cold Tally
text: In a conflict you did not start, ignore the first point of Stress you would suffer each scene.

effects.text: Ignore the first Stress each scene in conflicts you did not start

name: The Voice
text: Spend 2 Momentum after a successful COMMUNICATE test to compel one simple, immediate action from a listener untrained against it.

effects.text: Compel one simple action (2 Momentum)

name: Prana-Bindu Calm
text: When you resist fear, pain or poison, re-roll one d20 on the DISCIPLINE test.

effects.text: Re-roll one d20 when resisting fear, pain or poison

name: Truthsense
text: When someone lies to you face to face, the Narrator must tell you a lie was spoken (but not which part).

effects.text: Always know when a face-to-face lie is spoken

name: The Slow Blade
text: Against a shielded foe, the first complication on your BATTLE test is ignored.

effects.text: Ignore the first complication on BATTLE vs shielded foes

name: Guardian’s Step
text: When an ally within reach is attacked, spend 1 Momentum to take the attack yourself.

effects.text: Intercept an attack on an adjacent ally (1 Momentum)

name: Read the Feint
text: In a duel, after your opponent rolls, spend 1 Momentum to force them to re-roll their best die.

effects.text: Force an opponent to re-roll their best die in a duel (1 Momentum)

name: Name and Seal
text: Once per session, invoke your House to open a door, an audience or a ledger that would otherwise stay shut.

effects.text: Open one closed door, audience or ledger per session

name: Courtly Poise
text: In an intrigue conflict, your first COMMUNICATE test each scene gains one bonus d20 at no cost.

effects.text: +1 free d20 on the first COMMUNICATE test in intrigue

name: Heir’s Burden
text: When you take Stress protecting your House’s honor, gain 1 Momentum.

effects.text: +1 Momentum when taking Stress for your House

name: Walk Without Rhythm
text: On open sand, reduce the Difficulty of MOVE tests to avoid drawing a worm by 1.

effects.text: -1 Difficulty on MOVE tests to avoid worms

name: Water Discipline
text: You and anyone you lead ignore the dehydrated condition for one extra day.

effects.text: Delay the dehydrated condition by one day for your group

name: Desert Power
text: When you fight on ground you chose, spend 1 Momentum to inflict 2 extra Stress.

effects.text: +2 Stress on ground you chose (1 Momentum)

name: Imperial Conditioning
text: Any attempt to compel you to harm a patient automatically fails.

effects.text: Immune to compulsion to harm a patient

name: Field Surgery
text: After a scene, remove 2 Stress from an ally you treat, or clear WOUNDED with an UNDERSTAND test (Difficulty 2).

effects.text: Remove 2 Stress from a treated ally, or clear WOUNDED (D2)

name: Diagnose Poison
text: Name the poison in any victim you examine; the Narrator also tells you the likeliest way it was given.

effects.text: Automatically identify poisons and their delivery

name: Cover Identity
text: Once per adventure, reveal a prepared false identity that fits where you are; it is accepted without a test.

effects.text: One accepted false identity per adventure

name: Dead Drop
text: Spend 1 Momentum to have already hidden a small item (blade, message, vial) where you now stand.

effects.text: Retroactively stash a small item (1 Momentum)

name: Shadow’s Patience
text: After watching a full scene without acting, the Narrator reveals one hidden agenda of someone present.

effects.text: Learn one hidden agenda after a silent scene

name: A Price for Everything
text: Reduce the Difficulty of bribes, haggling and favor-trading by 1.

effects.text: -1 Difficulty on bribes and haggling

name: Blind Routes
text: You know an unpatrolled way in or out of any settlement on Arrakis; using it costs time, not tests.

effects.text: Enter or leave settlements unseen at the cost of time

name: Cut and Run
text: When a scene turns violent, spend 1 Momentum to leave before anyone can act against you.

effects.text: Exit a violent scene before anyone acts (1 Momentum)

name: Reading the Land
text: Spend 1 Momentum to predict a sandstorm, spice blow or worm sign one scene before it happens.

effects.text: Predict a desert hazard one scene ahead (1 Momentum)

name: Ecological Mind
text: UNDERSTAND tests about water, plants, weather and the spice cycle gain one bonus d20 at no cost.

effects.text: +1 free d20 on ecological UNDERSTAND tests

name: Friend of the Sietch
text: Fremen treat you as a guest rather than a stranger until you give them cause otherwise.

effects.text: Fremen start as hosts, not strangers

name: The Guild Remembers
text: Once per session, call in a favor of passage, transport or silence that no House may openly refuse.

effects.text: One unrefusable favor of passage or silence per session

name: Prescient Hedge
text: Before rolling, spend 2 Momentum to declare one die a success whatever it shows.

effects.text: Set one die to a success before rolling (2 Momentum)

name: Neutral Ground
text: While you speak for the Guild, anyone starting a physical conflict in your presence must first pay 2 Threat.

effects.text: Starting violence near you costs 2 Threat

name: Hardened
text: Your Stress track is one point longer than normal.

effects.text: +1 maximum Stress

name: Sharp-Eyed
text: When you search a room or watch a crowd, re-roll one d20 that did not score a success.

effects.text: Re-roll one failed d20 when searching or observing

name: Well-Connected
text: Once per adventure, name a contact in the current city who owes you a small favor. The Narrator decides what they want next time.

effects.text: One favor-owing contact per adventure

name: Spice Tolerance
text: You ignore the first dose of spice each day when tracking addiction, and treat spice withdrawal as one step less severe.

effects.text: Spice withdrawal is one step milder

name: Shield-Trained
text: While wearing a shield belt, you do not suffer the +1 Difficulty for fighting in a shield, and slow strikes against you need 1 extra Momentum.

effects.text: No shield penalty; slow blades need +1 Momentum against you

name: Desert-Wise
text: You know the basics of stillsuit care and water discipline. The first exposure or dehydrated consequence each adventure is downgraded to a complication.

effects.text: Downgrade the first desert consequence to a complication

name: Silver Tongue
text: When you spend Momentum to Obtain Information during a conversation, ask one extra question.

effects.text: +1 question when spending Momentum to Obtain Information
